scope: System-only minimal sprite sample and Preview rejection visibility repair
changes: Existing preview.mjs exposes --sprite-sample PNG ATLAS FRAME_MS FRAME_ID... for an explicitly requested new standalone sample. It refuses existing package/build/output files.
Dependency-free static player consumes the existing rectangle-only atlas format, with no grid assumption or artwork modification. Existing Sharp inspects decoded image/alpha.
Existing measurement and Preview are reused. --sprite-capture runs a fixed host-owned driver, retaining samples and video under .beegame/tmp, with real frame-coverage, pause and resume assertions.
Full samples stay in observation.json; CLI output is a compact summary. Assertions and missing recording dependencies fail explicitly without installation or retry.
Project execution seeds only the pinned Playwright version's already-installed FFmpeg into its private cache. Host cache permissions are not expanded.
Dashboard propagates Preview start rejection to the panel. The panel retains the message across idle polling and clears it on retry; another project does not display it.

previewDiagnosis.backend: A post-measurement tests/capture.mjs addition is an exportable-source change; Preview correctly returns HTTP 409 measurement-stale even when runtime artifact bytes are unchanged.
previewDiagnosis.transport: The adapter preserves the backend error message, status and code.
previewDiagnosis.display: Dashboard previously caught the rejection and only emitted a 3000-ms Toast. The panel's callback then resolved; it had neither an error state nor a failed build report and returned to standby.
previewDiagnosis.historicalLimit: Source and offline regressions establish the lost persistent error state. They do not prove whether a Toast was briefly visible during the historical run.

offlineVerification: sprite-sample.test.ts: existing atlas format and invalid input; non-overwrite and byte-preserving build; actual managed static Preview server; real sandboxed browser playback; deliberately broken pause/resume; missing FFmpeg; retained evidence; unchanged exportable sources and artifact hashes
project-execution-access.test.ts: existing project sandbox, cache/read boundaries and shell tests passed
agent-measurement.test.ts (measurement read API): settled interrupted Preview stays allowed; temporary evidence stays current; late project test source returns the exact 409 rejection
agent-tools.test.ts (autonomous tools): existing auth, capability and context regression passed
skill-play-capture.test.ts: both existing helper compatibility and actual video/audio/failed-driver evidence regressions passed
BeeGameLivePreviewPage.test.tsx and beeGameAdapter.test.ts: 85 tests passed, including rejection transport, persistent panel message, retry and project separation
Node syntax checks and git diff --check passed
limits: Offline synthetic fixtures only; no new image-generation or real-project end-to-end acceptance was performed.
The sample supports PNG and explicitly ordered equal-size, untrimmed, unrotated frames, 2..32 frames at 50..500 ms each. It is not a general animation engine.
Mechanical playback checks do not certify pose quality, natural motion, identity consistency or aesthetics. Existing repeated-pose artwork remains unchanged and unaccepted.
Running BGS services were not restarted; this record verifies source changes, not deployment of the new runtime.
